info.name: SmartFoodOps — panel demo (success + failure catalog)
info.description:
Run folders 00→06 top-to-bottom, one Send at a time; 07 is optional chaos theater with docker commands in each description.

Prereqs: `make up-m3 && make seed` (m3 = the m2 set + the notification service the bell folder needs) — gateway on localhost:8080.

Every request carries PASS/FAIL tests (open the Test Results tab) and chains its captures (tokens, ids) into collection variables — nothing is pasted by hand. The placement folder PREDICTS each order id locally with uuid5(sub:key) before the server sees the request — open the Postman Console to narrate it.

item.description: Runs on a THROWAWAY user (minted in step 1) so killing its session never hurts the demo customer.

item.name: 04 · Kitchen — the owner drives, the saga referees
item.description: Run within ~3 min of confirming order A (the accept window is 180s). Every reply is idempotent-by-state.

item.name: Accept order A → 202 (signalled to the saga)

item.name: Accept AGAIN → 200 (same verdict = replay, not error)

request.description: A kitchen tablet double-tap is not a conflict. 200 = the row already moved to ACCEPTED (same-verdict replay); 202 = you double-tapped faster than the saga moved the row, and the duplicate signal was absorbed by first-verdict-wins. Both are the safe answer.

item.name: 05 · Cancellation & the declined card
item.description: Cancels are idempotent BY STATE (202 submitted / 200 already-done / 409 too-late). The declined card proves money failures arrive as order state — the API never lies with a 500.

item.name: 07 · Chaos theater (needs the terminal)
item.description:
Each request names the docker command to run FIRST — the same drills the team ran for ADR-0023/0024 sign-off. Terminal prefix:

cd "/Users/emumba/Smart Food/SmartFoodOps" && docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml --profile core --profile apps <stop|start> <service>

item.name: [temporal STOPPED] Place → 503, and NOTHING is written

request.description:
RUN FIRST:  cd "/Users/emumba/Smart Food/SmartFoodOps" && docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml --profile core --profile apps stop temporal

The orchestrator is on the checkout path (ADR-0023's accepted cost). Because there is no key table, this failure leaves NO row and NO lock — nothing to take over, nothing to garbage-collect.

item.name: [temporal STARTED] Same key → 202 on the PREDICTED id

request.description:
RUN FIRST:  cd "/Users/emumba/Smart Food/SmartFoodOps" && docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml --profile core --profile apps start temporal   (give it ~10s)

The retry is not a 'takeover' of anything — it just runs, and lands on the exact id Postman predicted before the outage.

request.description: The honest cost of the pending path: the id is real, the workflow is durable, the row just is not visible yet. The FE polls through this window.

item.name: [worker STARTED] Read again → the order materialized

request.description:
RUN FIRST:  cd "/Users/emumba/Smart Food/SmartFoodOps" && docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml --profile core --profile apps start order-worker   (give it ~10s)

Temporal held the intent the whole time. The saga now runs it forward: PLACED → … → CONFIRMED.
